project.name: my-hw-bot
project.description: A production Python pipeline that collects Hot Wheels news, filters and deduplicates articles, transcreates accepted items into Russian, and publishes them on a fixed schedule.

milestone.title: Broad-pair dedup precision release
milestone.description: Release and verify a production dedup rule that soft-flags a shared broad series only when it is the stated subject of both article titles, while preserving distinctive blocking, fail-open behavior, truthful operator diagnostics, and safe publication timing.

tasks.title: Confirm the production failure mode and current dedup path
tasks.description: Document the measured false-positive pattern, the existing pair-rule flow, available evidence, and implementation constraints.

tasks.title: Approve measurable release requirements
tasks.description: Define and validate acceptance criteria for broad-pair precision, preserved distinctive blocking, fail-open behavior, diagnostics, and live verification.

tasks.title: Validate the technical design and release contract
tasks.description: Specify the symmetric title-subject rule, continued candidate scan, capped set-overlap backstop, telemetry, tests, rollout, and rollback boundaries.

tasks.title: Approve the validated technical specification
tasks.description: Record explicit approval of the reviewed technical specification before implementation begins.

tasks.title: Validate and approve the atomic execution plan
tasks.description: Decompose the specification into ten ordered implementation, audit, release, and observation tasks and validate their dependencies.

tasks.title: Build the sanitized production regression corpus and scorer
tasks.description: Create the 24-pair sanitized evidence corpus, stable fixture, integrity checks, and deterministic baseline scorer without operational or private data.

tasks.title: Implement subject-aware broad-pair decisions and the capped backstop
tasks.description: Require the shared broad series in both effective titles, continue scanning later candidates, preserve distinctive precedence, and prevent subject-rejected matches from hard-blocking through set overlap.

tasks.title: Add truthful E014 reasons, bounded logs, and suppression telemetry
tasks.description: Implement reason-specific operator messages, safe subject-rejection diagnostics, daily suppression counts, and exact deferral only for final soft flags.

tasks.title: Update project knowledge and rollout documentation
tasks.description: Document the title-subject rule, non-terminal suppression path, capped backstop, telemetry semantics, deployment safeguards, and observation contract.

tasks.title: Complete the feature code audit
tasks.description: Review the final implementation, lifecycle behavior, diagnostics, tests, and documentation for correctness, clarity, and preserved dedup invariants.

tasks.title: Complete the feature security audit
tasks.description: Review fail-open safety, irreversible-block protection, log redaction, corpus sanitization, malformed input handling, and unchanged review authorization.

tasks.title: Complete the feature test audit
tasks.description: Review corpus integrity, behavioral assertions, boundary coverage, state verification, and regression protection for distinctive and fail-open paths.

tasks.title: Pass pre-deployment acceptance and full regression QA
tasks.description: Trace every release criterion to evidence, run focused and full tests, validate JSON, run scoped hooks, and block release on any failed safety condition.

tasks.title: Deploy the approved build through the manual production flow
tasks.description: Release the verified commit outside the protected publication window, preserve a rollback target, and confirm clean service startup without forcing a tick or test article.

tasks.title: Verify live dedup precision after deployment
tasks.description: Observe natural dedup decisions for the approved window, classify E014 outcomes, reconcile suppression counts, and confirm no unexpected E015 or fail-open regression.

blockers.description: The 24-pair sanitized regression corpus requires explicit authorization for a read-only export limited to public article identifiers, titles, source names, and existing dedup fingerprints.
